spec.name: Baba Yaga's Hut on Chicken Legs
spec.description: A Slavic folk-art log hut with carved trim and a red shingle roof, standing on two golden scaly chicken legs with big clawed feet, on a mossy mound with a stake fence and a mortar.
spec.layout: The hut faces +Z: a steep tented roof with a red shingle skirt rises from the cabin walls at y=3.0 to a ridge at y≈5.0, and the front gable is crowned by a carved wooden horse head (konёk) with a flax mane, so the hut's silhouette reads from the front as a pointed, beaked roof over a chunky cabin. The cabin is a square log izba, footprint x −1.5..1.5, z −1.8..1.8, from y=1.6 to y=3.0, built of stacked logs with visible round log ends at the corners; the front face carries a plank door with painted iron hinges and a small glowing amber lantern, flanked by two windows in tall white carved nalichniki frames with red-and-teal sun rosettes; a third window sits on the left flank. Below, two bird legs step down from the cabin's underside at the legAnchor mounts: feathered cream thighs with rust patches, golden scaly shins, backward-bent ankle hocks, and big three-toed feet with a rear spur that plant on the ground at y=0, one foot a half-step forward (z≈0.5) and the other back, giving the hut a walking pose. The ground part is a mossy mound with dirt edges filling the box below the hut, a few grey stones, two birch-stake fence posts topped by carved skulls, and a leaning wooden mortar with pestle beside the front foot. The folk style shows everywhere: carved white trim with zig-zag and solar rosette motifs, painted red and teal door and shutter accents, gold trim on the gable board, and thick chunky low-poly shapes throughout.

parts.builds: Two stylised chicken legs, mirrored, walking pose. Each starts at its legAnchor mount under the cabin: a feathered thigh of overlapping rounded feather layers (cream feathers with a few rust patches, built as tapered blades seated along the thigh tube), a chunky knee knob, a golden scaly shin (swept tube with small overlapping scale discs stuck on, gold legScale with inkDark outlines), a backward-bent ankle hock with a small feather cuff, and a big three-toed foot: a low foot pad, three forward toes of tapered segments with pale keratin claws that press into the ground, and one rear spur toe with its claw. Toes rest on the mossy mound at y=0. Thighs carry the hip and knee joints, shins the ankle joint, feet the toe joint. All leg parts ride hipL/kneeL/ankleL/toeL and hipR/kneeR/ankleR/toeR.
parts.attaches: Thigh tops plug into the cabin underside at mounts legAnchorL and legAnchorR, shared with the cabin part; toes touch the ground part at mount ground.

parts.builds: The log izba from y=1.6 to y=3.0: walls of stacked horizontal logs (warm log colour, a darker logDark row or two low down for shade), with round log-end discs proud at the four corners; a log floor rim and short hanging planks under the wall base. The front face (+Z) carries: a plank door (vertical planks in plank colour, painted iron strap hinges and a gold handle plate, a small carved architrave of trim wood, a tiny glowing amber lantern hanging beside it on a wrought bracket); two windows left and right of the door, each a dark shuttered opening in a tall carved nalichniki frame of trim white wood with a red-and-teal sun rosette at its crown, zig-zag carving strips down the jambs and a small shutter wing in paintTeal with paintRed accents. One further window on the left flank (−X), same frame style, smaller. A thin trim board runs along the wall top under the eaves. All cabin parts ride the body joint.
parts.attaches: Wall underside receives the legs at mounts legAnchorL and legAnchorR; wall top hands off to the roof at mount roofBase (y=3.0), shared with the roof part.

parts.builds: The steep tented roof over the cabin: two slopes of overlapping red shingle rows (roofRed with roofDark shadow rows near the eaves), scalloped row edges reading as hand-split wood shakes, rising from the eave plane at y=3.0 to the ridge at y≈5.0; a cream ridge cap of trim wood along the peak; cream eave boards wrapping the bottom edge; carved side wind boards (povoloty) with zig-zag motifs sweeping up the roof ends. The front gable at z≈+1.8 is filled with vertical plank fronton boards, a trim gable board framing it, a large carved gold solar rosette at its centre and red-and-teal painted horse motifs; the back gable is plain planks with a small rosette. At the ridge's front end sits the konёk: a carved wooden horse head in trim wood with an inkDark carved eye, a flowing mane of tapered gold-and-plank blades streaming back along the ridge, and small pointed ears. A chimney of short stacked logs pokes from the back slope near the ridge with three grey smoke puffs drifting up from its mouth. All roof parts ride the body joint.
parts.attaches: Eave plane rests on the cabin wall top at mount roofBase (y=3.0); the konёk head and ridge run above the gable peak of the cabin part.

parts.builds: The diorama base under the hut: a low mossy mound (moss green top, dirt-brown sloped rim) roughly filling the box footprint below y≈0.6, with lichen patches and a few scattered pebbles and two grey stones; the chicken feet plant into it at mount ground. Beside the front foot leans a carved wooden mortar (plank colour with a carved zig-zag band and rim cracks) with a thick pestle; near the back left stand two birch-stake fence posts (pale trim wood, pointed tops, inkDark carved faces) each topped by a small carved skull with dark eye sockets and a row of teeth; a cluster of two red-capped mushrooms with cream stems grows at the mound's edge. No joints; static props.
parts.attaches: Sits under everything; the legs part's toe claws press into its mound surface at mount ground, and it stays clear of the door approach.
